title: Core: AS2 increment/decrement operators (++, --)
description: Test compilation of: i++, i--, ++i, --i, arr[i]++, obj.x++, obj.x--. Verify ActionIncrement (0x50) for ++ and ActionDecrement (0x51) for --. Test post-increment vs pre-increment behavior at bytecode level. Test compound: i += 1 vs i++. Test in for-loop context: for(var i=0;i<5;i++).
